Class ThrowingTraceListener

Namespace: osu.Framework.Logging
Assembly: osu.Framework.dll

A System.Diagnostics.TraceListener that throws exceptions when a trace is hit. This allows consistent behaviour across runtimes (ie. under Mono where no winforms dialog is displayed on encountering an exception).

public class ThrowingTraceListener : TraceListener, IDisposable
